Name: Zoomy Farmer
Author: Geko_X
Description:
Stardew Valley 1.6 supported!

This mod adds lets the farmer sprint, at the cost of stamina. Additionally, floor tiles can be used to add additional speed, turning your paths into roads.

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
How to use
Hold down the sprint button (Left Control by default) and zoom!

Config
`sprintSpeed*`: What speed to move at when sprinting. Normal run speed is 5. Default is 7.
`staminaDrainPerSecond*`: How much stamina to drain per each second of sprinting. Default is 1.
`enableStaminaDrain*`: If stamina is used when sprinting. Defaults to true.
`fasterOnFloorTiles*`: Adds a slight speed increase if sprinting on floor tiles. Default is true.
`additionalFloorSpeed*`: How much to increase the sprint speed by when sprinting on floor tiles and fasterOnFloorTiles is enabled. Default is 1.

`sprintKey`: The key to hold to sprint. Default is LeftControl.
`alternateSprintKey`: An alternate key to use to sprint. Default is LeftStick.
`toggleSprint`: Enables toggle sprint. Default is true (press to start/stop sprint).
`enableSprintWhenWaking`: Automatically sprints when getting out of bed. This only works when togglesprint is enabled. Default is true.

`multiplayerSync`: Sync the host's config to the clients. Default is true. This only needs to be set on the host, and only the starred(*) config values are sent.

**NOTE: Setting either of the sprint keys to the same keybind as `run`can cause unintended behavior!**

Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows. Untested on Android.

*   Works in single player and multiplayer (online, split screen, or both). Host configs can be enforced to all connected players.

*   Works with both keyboard/mouse and a gamepad by default.
